# Sharp Sighted Photos

> Story portraits for people. Headshots and films for businesses. On location across Dallas Fort Worth and the 121 corridor, by Dean Draper.

Sharp Sighted Photos is the portrait and film branch of Sharp Sighted Studio, founded in 2022 by Dean Draper. One person plans, shoots, and edits every project.

- Phone: (214) 233-5338, text preferred
- Email: dean@sharpsightedstudio.com
- Service area: Denton and Dallas Fort Worth, including Allen, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Lewisville, Coppell, Grapevine, Southlake, and Colleyville. Travel is free within 30 miles of Denton.
- First step: a free 15-minute Connection Call.

## For You
- Story portraits for people who hate posing. Clients tell their story, and Dean photographs them living it. Packages: The Verse ($900), The Story ($1,700), The Epic ($4,000), founding rates through December 25, 2026. Framed prints are included.
- Portrait gift cards for the Verse and the Story.

## For Your Business
- Corporate headshots: the Standard Set ($600 setup plus $70 to $90 per person) and the Featured Set (add $250 to $350 per person, or $900 for one executive).
- Brand films: Testimonial Set ($1,500), Brand Story Film ($1,800), and monthly plans from $800 a month. Nonprofits get 20% off list prices.

## The brand
One branch of Sharp Sighted Studio (https://sharpsightedstudio.com), alongside Sharp Sighted Media (real estate media) and Sharp Sighted Studio (creative community and education). Tagline: Stay Sharp. Stay Seen. Stay Human.
